testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect Sketch commands outside sketch edit: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/ribbon-command-availability/ribbon-command-availability.feature:5:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect Sketch commands outside sketch edit ✔ Given a part containing an existing sketch is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And sketch edit is inactive ✔ When the user selects the Sketch ribbon tab ✔ Then Line, Circle, Arc, Rectangle, Fillet, Text and Point are enabled in Create ✔ And Project Geometry is disabled ✔ And the commands in Modify, Pattern, Constrain, Insert and Format are disabled ✔ And the active part and model browser remain visible

testcase.name: Scenario: Revisit Sketch from another ribbon tab: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/ribbon-command-availability/ribbon-command-availability.feature:14:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Revisit Sketch from another ribbon tab ✔ Given a part containing an existing sketch is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And sketch edit is inactive ✔ And the Sketch ribbon tab is selected ✔ When the user selects the 3D Model ribbon tab ✔ And the user selects the Sketch ribbon tab again ✔ Then Line, Circle, Arc, Rectangle, Fillet, Text and Point remain enabled in Create ✔ And Project Geometry remains disabled ✔ And the commands in Modify, Pattern, Constrain, Insert and Format remain disabled ✔ And the active part and model browser remain visible

testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect Sketch ribbon while editing an existing sketch: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/ribbon-command-availability/ribbon-command-availability.feature:25:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect Sketch ribbon while editing an existing sketch ✔ Given a part containing an existing sketch is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And sketch edit is inactive ✔ When the user opens the existing sketch from the model browser ✔ Then the Sketch ribbon tab is selected ✔ And the 2D sketch workspace shows the existing profile ✔ And Create, Modify, Pattern, Constrain, Insert and Format groups are displayed ✔ And Finish is available to exit sketch editing ✔ When the user selects Line ✔ Then the Line command prompt requests a start point ✔ And the Line tooltip indicates line and arc creation ✔ When the user exits sketch editing with Finish ✔ Then the previous part workspace and ribbon context return ✔ And the existing sketch remains in the model browser

testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect component commands in an active assembly: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/ribbon-command-availability/ribbon-command-availability.feature:41:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect component commands in an active assembly ✔ Given the saved empty assembly fixture "fixtures/cad/blank-metric-assembly.oad" is active in the MCAD Software ✔ Then the assembly ribbon offers commands to place and create components ✔ And the assembly document remains active ✔ And no assembly command has been started

testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect view and annotation commands in an active drawing: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/ribbon-command-availability/ribbon-command-availability.feature:48:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect view and annotation commands in an active drawing ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-drawing.odd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ When the user selects the Place Views ribbon tab ✔ Then the Place Views ribbon displays Create, Modify, Sketch and Sheets groups ✔ When the user selects the Annotate ribbon tab ✔ Then the Annotate ribbon displays Dimension, Text and Symbols commands ✔ And the drawing sheet remains visible
